learning_outcomes.text: Student will be able to solve simple mechatronic tasks.

syllabus_topics: Introduction of the robotic kit, introduction of the NXT-G language and development environment.
First program, debugging the program, working with hardware.
NXT-G: cycles and program branching, creating user blocks.
Mechatronic systems - introduction to the problems.
NXC - alternative programming language, development environment, program debugging.
Solution of typical problems in mobile robotics - line tracing with obstacles.
Solving typical mobile robotics problems - solving maze I.
Solving typical mobile robotics problems - solving maze II.
Solution of typical mobile robotics problems - sumo I.
Solving typical mobile robotics problems - sumo II.
assessment_rules: To get credit it is necessary to attend the lessons and to build the robot capable to solve simple tasks. The course is ended by a competition of created robots.
bibliography: Daniele Benedettelli. Creating Cool MINDSTORMS NXT Robots. Barkeley, CA: Apress, 2008. ISBN 1590599667.
degree: Bachelor's programme, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics - courses in English
